data.name: ADUK: Curse of the Spirits
data.detailed_description:
You wash ashore on a forbidden island, and every step you take brings you closer to the truth… or to the curse that’s been waiting for you.

ADUK: Curse of the Spirits is a first-person shooter blended with psychological horror and a story shrouded in mystery. Explore the lost island of Karasu, uncover ancient ruins, and survive against both the ruthless Greenstone Corporation and the unseen supernatural powers haunting the island. Every clue you uncover draws you deeper into the curse — and forces you to choose whether to break it… or embrace it.

Features

  • Explore and Survive – Search abandoned villages, bunkers, Ottoman, Roman, and Byzantine ruins, and hidden tombs.

  • Combat Meets Horror – Tight FPS gunplay mixed with the tension of horror.

  • The Unseen Enemy – Supernatural powers remain invisible, manipulating the world through sound, possession, and environmental terror.

  • Rich World-Building – Discover documents, notes, and artifacts inspired by history and mythology.

  • Intense Atmosphere – Depressive atmosphere, shifting weather, and soundscapes that adapt to your actions.

The island doesn’t want you to leave — and the truth may be worse than the curse itself.

Mature Content Description

This game contains frequent gunfire and combat violence, blood effects, and occasional disturbing imagery (such as corpses or body bags). It is not recommended for all ages.


ADUK: Curse of the Spirits is developed using CRYENGINE®.

data.short_description: Washed ashore on a forbidden island, you face ruthless soldiers and an invisible terror. Every step brings you closer to breaking the curse… or embracing it forever.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian, Czech
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard & Mouse; Headphones recommended for horror immersion.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for smooth loading and streaming.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of violence and disturbing themes. Players will encounter blood, corpses, and armed combat against human enemies. The game also features strong horror elements, including frightening audio/visual effects, psychological tension, and supernatural themes. There is no nudity, sexual content, or depiction of sexual assault. There are no drug or alcohol use depictions.
